pairs: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen post mortem duorum filiorum Aaron,
And the Lord spoke to Moses, after the death of the two sons of Aaron,
quando offerentes ignem alienum interfecti sunt:
when they were destroyed for offering strange fire.
et præcepit ei,
And he instructed him,
dicens:
saying:
Loquere ad Aaron fratrem tuum,
Speak to your brother Aaron,
ne omni tempore ingrediatur sanctuarium,
so that he may not, at any time, enter into the Sanctuary,
quod est intra velum coram propitiatorio quo tegitur arca,
which is within the veil, before the propitiatory by which the ark is covered,
ut non moriatur (quia in nube apparebo super oraculum),
so that he may not die, (for I will appear in a cloud above the oracle)
nisi hæc ante fecerit:
unless he will have done these things beforehand.
vitulum pro peccato offeret,
He shall offer a calf for sin,
et arietem in holocaustum.
and a ram as a holocaust.
Tunica linea vestietur,
He shall be vested with a linen tunic.
feminalibus lineis verenda celabit:
He shall conceal his nakedness with linen undergarments.
accingetur zona linea,
He shall be wrapped with a linen belt,
cidarim lineam imponet capiti:
and he shall impose a linen headdress on his head.
hæc enim vestimenta sunt sancta: quibus cunctis,
For these are holy vestments. All of these he shall put on,
cum lotus fuerit, induetur.
after he has been washed.
Suscipietque ab universa multitudine filiorum Israël duos hircos pro peccato,
And he shall receive, from the entire multitude of the sons of Israel, two he-goats for sin,
et unum arietem in holocaustum.
and one ram as a holocaust.
Cumque obtulerit vitulum,
And when he has presented the calf,
et oraverit pro se et pro domo sua,
and has prayed for himself and for his own house,
duos hircos stare faciet coram Domino in ostio tabernaculi testimonii:
he shall cause the two he-goats to stand in the sight of the Lord at the entrance to the tabernacle of the testimony.
mittensque super utrumque sortem,
And casting lots over them both,
unam Domino,
one is to be offered to the Lord,
alteram capro emissario:
and the other is to be the emissary goat.
cujus exierit sors Domino,
The one whose lot fell out to be offered to the Lord,
offeret illum pro peccato:
he shall offer for sin.
cujus autem in caprum emissarium, statuet eum vivum coram Domino,
But the one who is to be the emissary goat shall stand before the Lord,
ut fundat preces super eo,
so that he may pour the prayers upon him,
et emittat eum in solitudinem.
and may send him away into the wilderness.
His rite celebratis,
After these things have been duly celebrated,
offeret vitulum,
he shall offer the calf,
et rogans pro se,
and praying for himself
et pro domo sua,
and for his own house,
immolabit eum:
he shall immolate it.
assumptoque thuribulo, quod de prunis altaris impleverit,
And taking up the censer, which he has filled from the burning coals of the altar,
et hauriens manu compositum thymiama in incensum,
and drawing up with his hands the aromatic compound for incense,
ultra velum intrabit in sancta:
he shall enter within the veil, into the holy place,
ut,
so that when the aromatics are placed upon the fire,
positis super ignem aromatibus,
its cloud and vapor may cover the oracle,
nebula eorum et vapor operiat oraculum quod est supra testimonium,
which is above the testimony,
et non moriatur.
and he may not die.
Tollet quoque de sanguine vituli,
Likewise, he shall take some of the blood of the calf,
et asperget digito septies contra propitiatorium ad orientem.
and sprinkle it with his finger seven times opposite the propitiatory, toward the east.
Cumque mactaverit hircum pro peccato populi,
And when he has slain the he-goat for the sin of the people,
inferet sanguinem ejus intra velum,
he shall carry its blood within the veil,
sicut præceptum est de sanguine vituli,
just as he was instructed to do with the blood of the calf,
ut aspergat e regione oraculi,
so that he may sprinkle it away from the area of the oracle,
et expiet sanctuarium ab immunditiis filiorum Israël,
and so that he may expiate the Sanctuary from the uncleanness of the sons of Israel,
et a prævaricationibus eorum,
and from their prevarications
cunctisque peccatis.
and every one of their sins.
Juxta hunc ritum faciet tabernaculo testimonii,
According to this rite,
quod fixum est inter eos,
he shall act toward the tabernacle of the testimony,
in medio sordium habitationis eorum.
which is fixed among them in the midst of the filth of their habitation.
Nullus hominum sit in tabernaculo, quando pontifex sanctuarium ingreditur, ut roget pro se,
Let no man be in the tabernacle when the high priest enters the Sanctuary in order to pray for himself,
et pro domo sua,
and for his house,
et pro universo cœtu Israël, donec egrediatur.
and for the entire assembly of Israel, until he exits.
Cum autem exierit ad altare quod coram Domino est, oret pro se,
And when he has exited to the altar which is before the Lord, let him pray for himself,
et sumptum sanguinem vituli atque hirci fundat super cornua ejus per gyrum:
and taking the blood of the calf, and of the he-goat, let him pour it upon its horns all around.
aspergensque digito septies,
And sprinkling with his finger seven times,
expiet,
let him expiate
et sanctificet illud ab immunditiis filiorum Israël.
and sanctify it from the uncleanness of the sons of Israel.
Postquam emundaverit sanctuarium,
After he has cleansed the Sanctuary,
et tabernaculum,
and the tabernacle,
et altare,
and the altar,
tunc offerat hircum viventem:
then let him offer the living goat.
et posita utraque manu super caput ejus,
And placing both hands upon its head,
confiteatur omnes iniquitates filiorum Israël,
let him confess all the iniquities of the sons of Israel,
et universa delicta
and all of their offenses and sins.
atque peccata eorum:
And calling these down upon its head,
quæ imprecans capiti ejus,
he shall send it away,
emittet illum per hominem paratum,
by means of a man prepared to do so,
in desertum.
into the desert.
Cumque portaverit hircus omnes iniquitates eorum in terram solitariam,
And when the goat has carried all their iniquities into a solitary land,
et dimissus fuerit in deserto,
and has been released into the desert,
revertetur Aaron in tabernaculum testimonii,
Aaron shall return into the tabernacle of the testimony.
et depositis vestibus,
And placing aside the vestments,
quibus prius indutus erat, cum intraret sanctuarium,
which he had worn before when he entered into the Sanctuary,
relictisque ibi,
and leaving them there,
lavabit carnem suam in loco sancto,
he shall wash his flesh in the holy place,
indueturque vestibus suis.
and he shall be clothed in his own garments.
Et postquam egressus obtulerit holocaustum suum,
And departing afterwards,
ac plebis,
he shall present his own holocaust and that of the people:
rogabit tam pro se quam pro populo:
he shall pray as much for himself as for the people.
et adipem, qui oblatus est pro peccatis,
And the fat which is offered for sins,
adolebit super altare.
he shall burn upon the altar.
Ille vero,
Yet truly,
qui dimiserit caprum emissarium, lavabit vestimenta sua, et corpus aqua,
he who has sent away the emissary goat shall wash his clothes and his body with water,
et sic ingredietur in castra.
and so he shall enter into the camp.
Vitulum autem, et hircum,
But the calf and the he-goat,
qui pro peccato fuerant immolati, et quorum sanguis illatus est in sanctuarium,
which were immolated for sin, and whose blood was brought into the Sanctuary to complete the expiation,
ut expiatio compleretur, asportabunt foras castra,
these shall be carried outside the camp and be burned with fire:
et comburent igni tam pelles quam carnes eorum, ac fimum:
as with their skins, so also with their flesh and dung.
et quicumque combusserit ea,
And whoever will have burned them shall wash his clothes
lavabit vestimenta sua et carnem aqua,
and flesh with water,
et sic ingredietur in castra.
and so he shall enter into the camp.
Eritque vobis hoc legitimum sempiternum:
And this shall be to you an everlasting ordinance.
mense septimo,
In the seventh month,
decima die mensis,
on the tenth day of the month,
affligetis animas vestras,
you shall afflict your souls,
nullumque opus facietis,
and you shall do no work,
sive indigena,
neither someone native born,
sive advena qui peregrinatur inter vos.
nor the newcomer who sojourns among you.
In hac die expiatio erit vestri,
On this day, there shall be atonement for you,
atque mundatio ab omnibus peccatis vestris: coram Domino mundabimini.
and also a cleansing from all your sins. You shall be cleansed in the sight of the Lord.
Sabbatum enim requietionis est,
For it is a Sabbath of rest,
et affligetis animas vestras religione perpetua.
and you shall afflict your souls as a perpetual observance.
Expiabit autem sacerdos,
And the priest who has been anointed,
qui unctus fuerit,
and whose hands have been consecrated to exercise the priesthood in the place of his father,
et cujus manus initiatæ sunt ut sacerdotio fungatur pro patre suo:
shall make atonement.
indueturque stola linea et vestibus sanctis,
And he shall be clothed with the linen robe and the holy vestments.
et expiabit sanctuarium et tabernaculum testimonii atque altare,
And he shall expiate the Sanctuary and the tabernacle of the testimony and the altar,
sacerdotes quoque et universum populum.
likewise the priest and all the people.
Eritque vobis hoc legitimum sempiternum,
And this shall be to you a perpetual law,
ut oretis pro filiis Israël,
that you pray for the sons of Israel,
et pro cunctis peccatis eorum semel in anno.
and for all their sins once a year. Therefore,
Fecit igitur sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi.
he did just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
